english: and according to Your own heart
and when they had called the roll
and pronounced a curse on them
of the things which should have been utterly destroyed
and they are to stone me
And shall stone him to death
and I will sing praises to You
by causing to pass through [the fire]
And will cause to be heard
I will cause you to hear
that I may announce to you
and I will let them hear
and as soon as we heard [these things]
and I caused them to hear it
then you shall sound an alarm
I have proclaimed the good news
